Question: An ice-cream novelty item consists of a cup in the shape of a \(4\)-inch-tall frustum of a right circular cone, with a \(2\)-inch-diameter base at the bottom and a \(4\)-inch-diameter base at the top, packed solid with ice cream, together with a solid cone of ice cream of height \(4\) inches, whose base, at the bottom, is the top base of the frustum. What is the total volume of the ice cream, in cubic inches?
